Welcome, Our Dearest Guests

A note before the details — please read this first.

Welcome to our barn wedding — y'all are invited, and we mean it. Thank you for coming all this way to Willow Creek to dance with us under string lights.

Everything you need is on this page: times, addresses, where to stay, what to wear, and the RSVP at the bottom. If anything is unclear, message us. We would rather answer twice than have you guess once.

— Hannah & Owen

✿ ✿ ✿

Our Story

How we met, and how we got here — in four moments.

2019 — A County Fair

We met by the pie stand

Hannah was judging pies; Owen was eating his way through the entries, unofficially. He offered her a bite of the winner. She offered him a job holding her clipboard. Both offers stood.

2020–2024 — The Country Habit

Weekends out of town

Every free weekend became the country — farmers' markets, porch swings, and long drives with the windows down. Owen drives; Hannah chooses the music. The habit never stopped.

May 2026 — On the Porch

He asked at sunset

On a warm evening on this very porch, as the light went gold over the fields, Owen asked properly, ring in a shirt pocket. Hannah said yes, then made him ask again so the sunset could be in the photo.

11 September 2027 — Today, With You

Now we want you in the room

String lights, wildflowers, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Venue, Travel & Stay

Flying in? Start here, then pick a hotel that fits your budget.

The Venue

Willow Creek Barn, Texas — our recommended base if you want one place for the whole celebration.

Open in Google Maps →

Getting Here

Austin-Bergstrom Airport (AUS) is the nearest airport. Allow about 1 hour by car to Willow Creek in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle

Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

Where to Stay

Price bands are indicative for planning only — please confirm live rates when you book.

Budget — country motels & innsIndicative band: lower nightly rates. Simple country stays near Willow Creek; allow a drive to the barn.
Mid-range — Willow Creek Town HotelIndicative band: mid nightly rates. A fifteen-minute drive from the barn, with breakfast.
Premium — Willow Creek Barn Cottages (venue stay)Indicative band: higher nightly rates. Stay where the wedding is — no travel on the night, and the morning after on the porch.

Travelling with children or elderly family? Tell us in the RSVP message and we will help you choose the most comfortable option.

A Note on Gifts

Your presence is the gift — truly. If you still wish to give, a contribution towards our honeymoon is welcome, and we will share details personally with anyone who asks. There is no online registry or payment link on this page, by design.

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Yes — children are welcome. Please include them in your guest count so we can seat and cater for them. The welcome evening in the barn yard is the most child-friendly part.

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Parking is available in the barn field car park. Arrive by 4:30 PM — the country road is unlit after dark, so plan your return ride in advance.

Rustic formal, soft colours and florals welcome. Avoid stilettos on barn floors and grass; wedges, flats or boots are safest.

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

September in Texas is warm by day and mild at night. The ceremony is partly outdoors on grass — flat or wedge shoes are essential, and a light layer for after sunset is wise.
